rows.title: Britax Römer Dualfix M Plus 360 Spin Car Seat - Carbon Black — Default Title
rows.description: The Britax Römer Dualfix M Plus is the car seat that grows with your little one while keeping everyday life simple and stress-free. Designed for children from 3 months to 4 years (61–105 cm, up to 20 kg), this versatile seat can rotate a full 360°, making it effortless to place, harness, and remove your child. Whether you prefer rearward-facing for extra safety or forward-facing when your child is ready, the DUALFIX M PLUS gives you ultimate flexibility without compromising on comfort or protection. Approved to the latest i-Size (R129) safety standards, it offers peace of mind for every journey. Standard delivery £4.95 below £75, free over £75. Local pickup £3.95 where available. Channel Islands from £5.95; postcode, size and direct-supplier restrictions can apply. Check product dispatch status and the final checkout total.
